change: Add an interactive reaction/diffusion example using ordinary float32 matrices, slice updates, fused dotted arithmetic and one updated texture per frame.
validation: 9 focused checks passed in 5.49s; Ruff and git diff --check passed.
coverage: Every cell after eight steps compared with an independent scalar Python reference on native/web and default/release targets.
Saved field independence, out-of-field paint and repeated simulation allocation cleanup.
Two native model test blocks in default/release builds.
Game web builds in default/release modes; native software render verifies dimensions and visible warm pattern pixels.

Manual browser smoke test: pause freezes at 128 steps after reseeding, paint adds a visible patch, all three sliders change values, resume advances to 700 steps with changed patterns. No console or network errors.
limits: The model uses a fixed outer boundary and an explicit unit-time stencil, not a general numerical solver.
Simulation speed is steps per rendered frame, not elapsed time.
Browser interaction was a manual smoke test. No general performance claim.
